MAJOR flooding hit parts of the Philippines from Tropical Storm Fengshen (Ramil). Thousands were evacuated, some areas badly submerged, and at least 10 people have died.

Roxas City received about 365.5mm (14.39 inches) of rain in a short period of time, over twice the normal October total.

📍 Capiz, Roxas City
